title: The Ossuary Host's bone ram
changes: When the Ossuary Host besieges a land, a bone ram now rolls from their camp toward the Hold gate with two bone soldiers beside it. It rolls faster at night.
Defending soldiers and heroes sworn to the defenders stop the ram while they stand in its way. At the gate it counts as three fighters for the Host.
Heroes sworn against the Host can wreck it. Defenders who wreck it earn valor for their clan and renown. A wrecked ram does not come back until the war's next turn.
